units.source_text: 鞠子说着挺起身子，像哄小动物似的，凝神望着自己的乳房，轻轻地摇了摇。

en.t: As Mariko spoke, she straightened herself, and, as if soothing a small animal, gazed intently at her own breasts and gently shook them.

units.source_text: 从这种肉体的摇荡中，我联想起了舞鹤湾的夕阳。

en.t: From that swaying of the flesh, I was reminded of the sunset over Maizuru Bay.

units.source_text: 夕阳的容易变幻与肉体的容易变幻在我心中结合在一起了。

en.t: The mutability of the sunset and the mutability of the body joined together in my mind.

units.source_text: 于是，我眼前的肉体也像夕阳一样，不久将被多层的夕云所包围，躺在夜的墓穴的深处。

en.t: And so the body before my eyes, like the sunset, would soon be surrounded by layer upon layer of evening clouds and lie deep within the grave pit of night.
This imagining put me at ease.
